proposition.statement: For this removed-result declaration, the live parent represents exactly its owned children by a finite acyclic child and next chain
For this removed-result declaration, chain child identities are pairwise distinct
For this removed-result declaration, child is NULL precisely when the child and next chain is empty
For this removed-result declaration, the first child's prev is the last child
For this removed-result declaration, the last child's next is NULL
For this removed-result declaration, every non-NULL next or prev target is a live child of that same parent
For this removed-result declaration, no concurrent writer mutates these links during the call
For this removed-result declaration, the parent is not a child
For this removed-result declaration, each nonfirst child's prev is its predecessor

#parent in #live && (quant all #c in #owned(#parent): #c in #children(#parent)) && (quant all #c in #children(#parent): #c in #owned(#parent) && #c in #live) && (quant all #c in #child(#parent): #c in #first(#parent)) && (quant all #c in #first(#parent): #c in #child(#parent)) && (quant all #b in #children(#parent): quant all #a in #pred(#parent, #b): #b in #next(#a)) && (quant all #c in #children(#parent): #c in #next_reach(#c) -> #false) && ((quant all #c in #child(#parent): #false) -> quant all #c in #children(#parent): #false) && ((quant all #c in #children(#parent): #false) -> quant all #c in #child(#parent): #false) && (quant all #b in #children(#parent): quant all #a in #pred(#parent, #b): #a in #prev(#b)) && (quant all #f in #first(#parent): quant all #l in #last(#parent): #l in #prev(#f)) && #nodup(#parent) && (quant all #c in #children(#parent): quant all #y in #next(#c) | #prev(#c): #y in #children(#parent) && #y in #live) && (quant all #l in #last(#parent): quant all #y in #next(#l): #false) && (#parent in #children(#parent) -> #false) && #concurrent |-> #keeps_links(#parent)
